id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the fan.

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#fancycle_speed-action)*

off_speed_cycle.docs:
**boolean**: Determines if the fan will cycle off after cycling though its highest speed. Can be `true` or `false`. If `false` fan will cycle to its lowest speed instead of turning off. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#fancycle_speed-action)*

cycle_speed.docs: Increments through speed levels of the fan with the given ID when executed. If the fan's speed level is set to maximum when executed, fan will cycle off unless `off_speed_cycle` is set to `false`.

toggle.docs: Toggles the ON/OFF state of the fan with the given ID when executed.

turn_off.docs: Turns the fan with the given ID off when executed.

direction.docs:
**string**: Set the direction of the fan. Can be either `forward` or `reverse`. Defaults to not changing the direction.

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#fanturn_on-action)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the fan.

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#fanturn_on-action)*

oscillating.docs:
**boolean**: Set the oscillation state of the fan. Defaults to not affecting oscillation.

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#fanturn_on-action)*

speed.docs:
**int**: Set the speed level of the fan. Can be a number between 1 and the maximum speed level of the fan.

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#fanturn_on-action)*

turn_on.docs: Turns the fan with the given ID on when executed.

bedjet.docs:
The `fan` platform exposes the BedJet's fan-related functionality, including on/off and speed control.

*See also: [BedJet](https://esphome.io/components/climate/bedjet#bedjet-fan)*

binary.docs:
The `binary` fan platform lets you represent any binary [Output Component](https://esphome.io/components/output/) as a fan.

*See also: [Binary Fan](https://esphome.io/components/fan/binary)*

hbridge.docs:
The `hbridge` fan platform allows you to use a compatible *h-bridge* (L298N, DRV8871, MX1508, BTS7960, L9110S, DRV8833, TB6612, etc.) to control a fan (or motor/solenoid).

*See also: [H-bridge Fan](https://esphome.io/components/fan/hbridge)*

speed.docs:
The `speed` fan platform lets you represent any float [Output Component](https://esphome.io/components/output/) as a fan that supports speed settings.

*See also: [Speed Fan](https://esphome.io/components/fan/speed)*

template.docs:
The `template` fan platform lets you create a fan interface using only triggers.

*See also: [Template Fan](https://esphome.io/components/fan/template)*

is_on.docs: This [condition](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-conditions) passes if the given fan is on or off.

direction_command_topic.docs:
**string**: The topic to receive fan direction commands on (options: forward, reverse, toggle).

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

direction_state_topic.docs:
**string**: The topic to publish fan direction state changes to (options: forward, reverse).

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

on_direction_set.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the fan direction is changed. See [`fan.on_direction_set` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fan#fan-on_direction_set-trigger).

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

on_oscillating_set.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the fan oscillating state is changed. See [`fan.on_oscillating_set` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fan#fan-on_oscillating_set-trigger).

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

on_preset_set.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the fan preset mode is changed. See [`fan.on_preset_set` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fan#fan-on_preset_set-trigger).

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

on_speed_set.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the fan speed is changed. See [`fan.on_speed_set` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fan#fan-on_speed_set-trigger).

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

on_state.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the fan state is changed. See [`fan.on_state` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fan#fan-on_state-trigger).

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

on_turn_off.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the fan is turned off. See [`fan.on_turn_on` / `fan.on_turn_off` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fan#fan-on_turn_on_off_trigger).

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

on_turn_on.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when the fan is turned on. See [`fan.on_turn_on` / `fan.on_turn_off` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fan#fan-on_turn_on_off_trigger).

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

oscillation_command_topic.docs:
**string**: The topic to receive oscillation commands on.

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

oscillation_state_topic.docs:
**string**: The topic to publish fan oscillation state changes to.

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

ALWAYS_ON.docs: Always initialize the fan as ON on bootup.

RESTORE_DEFAULT_OFF.docs: Attempt to restore state and default to OFF if not possible to restore.

RESTORE_DEFAULT_ON.docs: Attempt to restore state and default to ON.

RESTORE_INVERTED_DEFAULT_OFF.docs: Attempt to restore state inverted from the previous state and default to OFF.

RESTORE_INVERTED_DEFAULT_ON.docs: Attempt to restore state inverted from the previous state and default to ON.

restore_mode.docs:
Control how the fan attempts to restore state on boot.

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

speed_command_topic.docs:
**string**: The topic to receive speed commands on (options: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH).

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

speed_level_command_topic.docs:
**int**: The topic to receive numeric speed commands on (range: 0 to speed count).

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

speed_level_state_topic.docs:
**int**: The topic to publish numeric fan speed state changes to (range: 0 to speed count).

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

speed_state_topic.docs:
**string**: The topic to publish fan speed state changes to (options: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH).

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

id.docs:
**string**: Manually specify the ID for code generation. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

name.docs:
**string**: The name of the fan. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

icon.docs:
**icon**: Manually set the icon to use for the fan in the frontend.

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

internal.docs:
**boolean**: Mark this component as internal. Internal components will not be exposed to the frontend (like Home Assistant). Only specifying an `id` without a `name` will implicitly set this to true.

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

disabled_by_default.docs:
**boolean**: If true, then this entity should not be added to any client's frontend (usually Home Assistant) without the user manually enabling it (via the Home Assistant UI). Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*

entity_category.docs:
**string**: The category of the entity. See [https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties) for a list of available options. Set to `""` to remove the default entity category.

*See also: [Fan Component](https://esphome.io/components/fan#base-fan-configuration)*
